## buddy-sbx create task

Create and dispatch an autonomous agent task

### Synopsis

Create task submits an asynchronous agent task targeting a workspace.

```
buddy-sbx create task [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  # Create a task targeting a workspace with a prompt
  buddy-sbx create task --workspace repo-auth --prompt "Fix race condition in session manager"

  # Create a task with an agent profile and retry budget
  buddy-sbx create task -w repo-auth -p "Fix bug" --profile golang-default --max-attempts 2
```

### Options

```
  -b, --branch string      Target git branch
  -h, --help               help for task
      --max-attempts int   Maximum execution attempts (default 1)
  -n, --namespace string   Kubernetes namespace (defaults to user namespace)
      --profile string     Agent profile ID
  -p, --prompt string      Task instructions for the agent (required)
  -w, --workspace string   Target workspace name (required)
```

```
      --config string     Path to config file (default: ~/.buddy/config.yaml)
      --endpoint string   Buddy Gateway endpoint URL (overrides context)
      --token string      Authentication token (overrides context)
```
